title: Triangle inequality for finite sums
statement: Let $\\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\\iota$ be a type, let $s$ be a finite subset of $\\iota$, and let $f_i:\\Omega\\to\\mathbb R$ for each $i\\in\\iota$. The uniform $L^4$ norm of $x\\mapsto\\sum_{i\\in s}f_i(x)$ is at most $\\sum_{i\\in s}\\|f_i\\|_4$, where each norm is the uniform $L^4$ norm on $\\Omega$.
hypotheses_covered: $s$ is a finite subset of the index type $\\iota$
each $f_i$ is a real-valued function on $\\Omega$
